The ratio between the three angles of a quadrilateral is 3 : 4 : 9. The value of the fourth angle of the quadrilateral is 88°. What is the difference between the largest and the smallest angles of the quadrilateral?

question_en: The ratio between the three angles of a quadrilateral is 3 : 4 : 9. The value of the fourth angle of the quadrilateral is 88°. What is the difference between the largest and the smallest angles of the quadrilateral?
question_hi: एक चतुर्भुज के तीन कोणों का अनुपात 3 : 4 : 9 है। चतुर्भुज के चौथे कोण का मान 88° है। चतुर्भुज के सबसे बड़े और सबसे छोटे कोणों के बीच क्या अंतर है?
explanation:
• Sum of all 4 angles in a quadrilateral = 360°.
• Sum of the first 3 angles = 360° - 88° = 272°.
• Sum of ratio parts = 3 + 4 + 9 = 16x = 272 => x = 17°.
• Smallest angle = 3x = 3 * 17 = 51°.
• Largest angle = 9x = 9 * 17 = 153°.
• Difference = 153° - 51° = 102° (or 9x - 3x = 6 * 17 = 102°).
Therefore, Option (1) [102°] is 100% correct.

explanation: • By Pythagoras theorem: Length = √(Diagonal² - Breadth²) = √(20² - 12²) = √(400 - 144) = √256 = 16 cm. Option (1) is correct.
